name: parts-r3
note: Owner 2026-11-10, more head parts: hats f flower ring + tiara, m gold head band + crown + farmer's straw hat; facial hair m moustache, goatee (with moustache), mutton chops. One candidate each (OpenAI spend); extraction by tools/art/parts.js (key, align, diff). Prompts follow parts-r1. Each subject's `extract` is how its layer was cut (tools/art/parts.js, against the bald base head of probes-r1, then pasted from the head crop into the figure square: scale 342/512 at x 85).

hat-f-flowers.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering (soft painterly, flat colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, no texture). The attached close-up on magenta is the HEAD AND SHOULDERS of a BASE BODY of this game: a young woman, bald, in a tan undershift. Redraw that close-up EXACTLY as it is, pixel for pixel: the same bald head at the same size and position, the same face, eyes, brows, ears, neck, shoulders and undershift, changing NOTHING, and add ONLY her HEADWEAR: a RING OF FLOWERS, a flower crown: a wreath of small wildflowers (white daisies with yellow centres, small sky-blue and warm orange blossoms) and green leaves, sitting around the top of the bald head like a circlet, above the brow; it is FULL COLOUR (not grey), worn naturally at head size; the face, the eyes and the brows stay fully visible and unchanged. Everything that is not the added part stays identical. The background is a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere that is not the drawing: no gradient, no texture, no scene, no frame, no text; never pink, never magenta, never purple on the drawing itself.
hat-f-flowers.extract: key, align, diff --open 1 --defringe --min 0.02 --fill --faceclear female  [superseded by parts-r4: bigger flowers]
